Whether you visit us in Glendale or Scottsdale—from the moment you walk through our doors, you’ll feel like a valued member of our community. Our Expertise Your smile affects how you eat, speak, and feel about yourself. We focus on treatments that restore these essential functions and help you live more freely. Our team uses leading-edge technology to plan your surgery with great precision. This approach helps us minimize discomfort and makes your recovery faster and more predictable. We view our services not just as procedures, but as solutions to improve your quality of life. Our Specialties We offer a full range of oral surgery and periodontal services to meet your needs. Dental Implants Full Arch Restoration Bone Grafting Sinus Lift Tooth Extractions Wisdom Teeth Removal Corrective Jaw Surgery Sedation Options Impacted Canine Exposure TMJ Treatment Oral Pathology Abscessed Tooth Treatment Facial Trauma Repair Cleft Lip & Palate Repair Jaw Distraction Surgery (Distraction Osteogenesis) Gum Grafting Guided Tissue Regeneration Sleep Apnea Treatment Common Questions We are happy to answer any questions you might have. Here are a few things our patients often ask us. How do I make an appointment? You can call either of our offices directly during business hours. Our friendly staff will help you find a time that works for your schedule. You can also request an appointment through our website, and we will get back to you promptly. What if I have a dental emergency? If you are in severe pain or have an urgent issue, please call us right away. We do our best to see emergency cases as quickly as possible. If your emergency happens after hours, our answering service will direct you on what to do next. Do you accept my insurance? We work with many insurance providers to help you get the care you need. Please bring your insurance card to your visit. We will verify your coverage and explain your benefits clearly, so you know exactly what to expect. Is there parking available? Yes, both of our locations have ample parking available for our patients. You do not need to worry about finding a spot when you arrive for your visit. Learn More Facial Trauma Repair Get compassionate care for injuries to the face, jaw, or mouth, helping you heal and regain confidence. Learn More Lip & Palate Repair Benefit from advanced surgical care for cleft lip and palate concerns; supporting eating, speech, and self-esteem. Learn More Gum Grafting Restore lost gum tissue and protect sensitive tooth roots while improving the beauty of your smile. Learn More Sleep Apnea Treatment Treat snoring and disrupted sleep with airway solutions tailored to your needs, improving both rest and quality of life. We invite you to connect with our compassionate team and explore the right treatment plan for your needs—including details on recovery, sedation, and aftercare to keep you at ease. Schedule a Consultation Common Questions We know you may have questions before coming in. Here are some of the things our patients often ask: Do I need a referral to make an appointment? Often, you can schedule a consultation directly. In some cases, your insurance may require a referral from your dentist, so it helps to check your plan or call our office—we’re happy to guide you. Will my procedure be covered by insurance? Coverage varies by procedure and insurance plan. Our team is here to help you understand your benefits and costs up front, so there are no surprises. How do you help with dental anxiety? We understand that dental visits can be stressful for some people. Our welcoming environment, empathetic care, and variety of sedation options can help you feel relaxed and supported at every visit. Our goal is to make sure you feel comfortable, informed, and supported every step of the way. Schedule a Consultation Why You Might Need a Sinus Lift When you lose teeth in your upper jaw, the bone in that area can shrink over time. Sometimes, the sinus floor—the space just above your upper teeth—drops down because there isn’t enough bone to hold it up. If you want dental implants but have experienced bone loss, a sinus lift might be the solution. It gently adds the necessary height and width to your jawbone. This ensures your implants have a solid, secure place to anchor, giving you a smile that lasts for years to come. How the Procedure Works We want you to feel prepared and confident in your care. While the name might sound complex, the process itself is straightforward. Here is what you can expect: Gentle Preparation: First, we’ll carefully make a small opening in the gum tissue to reach the bone underneath Lifting the Sinus: We gently lift the sinus membrane upward to create a small space Placing the Graft: We place special bone graft material into that new space. This material bonds with your own bone over time Healing: We close the area to let it heal. Over the next several months, the graft hardens and becomes part of your natural jawbone Are You a Candidate? Every smile is unique, and we treat it that way. To find out if a sinus lift is right for you, we use leading-edge imaging tools like 3D scans. These pictures let us see the exact shape of your bone and sinuses. We look at your overall health and the amount of bone you currently have. Based on what we see, we will create a personalized plan just for you. Whether you need a lift before your implants or if we can do both at the same time, we will walk you through the best option for your health. The Benefits of Sinus Lift Surgery Choosing this procedure is an investment in your long-term oral health. It opens the door to dental implants, even if you thought you weren’t a candidate before. Here are a few benefits of getting a sinus lift: Strong Foundation: It provides the solid bone support needed for stable implants Prevents Bone Loss: It helps stop further deterioration of your upper jaw Natural Look: It supports your facial structure, helping you maintain a youthful, natural appearance Schedule a Sinus Lift Consultation If you have been told you don’t have enough bone for implants, there is still hope. A sinus lift can make permanent tooth replacement possible for you. Our caring team is ready to answer your questions and guide you toward your most confident smile. Schedule a Consultation Frequently Asked Questions We know you likely have concerns, and we are here to answer them simply. Here are some common questions our patients ask. Is the sinus lift procedure painful? To keep you comfortable, we use effective anesthesia to numb the area completely. Afterward, you might have some swelling or mild soreness, but we will provide you with a plan and medication to minimize discomfort and help you heal smoothly. How long does it take to heal? Recovery time varies from person to person. Typically, it takes about 4 to 9 months for the new bone to fully harden and merge with your jaw. We know waiting can be hard, but this time is crucial for ensuring your implants have a strong, lasting base. We will monitor your progress closely throughout the entire process. Can I have implants placed at the same time? In some cases, yes. If you have enough natural bone to provide some initial stability, we might be able to place the implant during the same visit as your sinus lift. We will evaluate your specific situation during your consultation and let you know if this is an option for you.
